    Duals of modules with a basis #

    For a left module M over a possibly noncommutative semiring R, the dual Hom_R(M, R) is a left Rᵐᵒᵖ-module, with scalars acting on the values on the right. A basis of M indexed by ι identifies this dual with the coordinate module ι → Rᵐᵒᵖ, by evaluating a functional at the basis vectors. No finiteness is assumed.

    The linear dual of a free module over a commutative ring has the same finrank as the module: for a finite basis it is identified with its dual (Module.Basis.toDualEquiv), and otherwise both finranks are 0. Over a field this is Mathlib's Subspace.dual_finrank_eq.

    Main definitions #

    • Module.Basis.oppositeDualEquiv: a basis indexed by ι identifies the dual, as a module over the opposite semiring, with ι → Rᵐᵒᵖ.

    Main results #

    • EFiniteCharacterizations.Module.dual_finrank_eq: finrank R (Dual R M) = finrank R M for a free module M.
